name: harvest
description: Proposes microservices from the jobs Victor repeats across Claude Code sessions. Builds and schedules nothing.

verbs.name: scan
verbs.description: Candidates from the sessions in a window, against this repo's parts, its external services, and Claude Code's skills. Saves them as harvest/latest.json in the data home. Makes one paid model call unless the reply is cached.

days.description: Length of the window in days, counted back from --until or from now.

until.description: ISO date or datetime. Sessions starting after it are excluded.

minSessions.description: Fewest known sessions a candidate must cite.

minObjects.description: Fewest different objects a candidate's citations must name.

root.description: Folder holding one folder of transcripts per project. Claude Code's projects folder by default.

skills.description: Folder holding one folder per skill. Claude Code's skills folder by default.
